summary: US military forces conducted strikes against IRGC targets in Iran following recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Persian Gulf and against American personnel in the region. Iranian state media reported explosions at US air bases in Jordan, while local sources reported casualties in Sirich and explosions in southern Iran. Israel announced the capture of a senior Hamas internal security commander in Gaza City during a joint Shin Bet and IDF operation.
key_points: US military confirmed strikes against IRGC targets in Iran following recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Persian Gulf and against American personnel in the region (Source: @almogboker78/18094).
Iranian state media IRIB reported explosions at US air bases in Jordan (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6733).
At least two people were killed and several wounded in an American airstrike on a wedding ceremony in the city of Sirich, Iran (Source: @asafroz/52993).
Israeli special forces captured the Hamas internal security chief, Muein al-Arabid, in a raid in Gaza City, with IDF airstrikes on surrounding military targets (Source: @manniefabian/59077).
Iran launched ballistic missiles from multiple provinces including Yazd, Kermanshah, Zanjan, Arak, and Kurdistan toward regional targets (Source: @kianmeli1/91385).
Explosions were reported in southern Iran and near the Strait of Hormuz, with local sources reporting damage and casualties (Source: @inon_yttach/9995).
Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps threatened that the US would apologize for the strikes, while Trump stated Iran would never acquire nuclear weapons (Source: @amitsegal/64470).
A child was killed and several injured when an Israeli airstrike hit a wedding hall in southern Iran, according to local reports (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388160).

sections.threat_assessment: The situation has rapidly escalated with direct US military action against IRGC targets in Iran, prompting retaliatory missile launches from multiple Iranian provinces. Iran's threats of further escalation and the closure of Jordanian airspace indicate a high risk of broader regional conflict. The capture of a senior Hamas commander by Israeli forces adds another layer of tension in Gaza, while Hezbollah-affiliated channels report ongoing cross-border activity in Lebanon. The involvement of multiple actors across the region increases the likelihood of unintended escalation.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are responding with heightened military activity, including Iranian missile launches toward US bases in Jordan and Hezbollah-affiliated channels reporting cross-border strikes in Lebanon. China and Egypt are conducting diplomatic engagement, with Chinese President Xi Jinping arriving in Cairo for talks with Egyptian President Sisi. The US has deployed the USS George Washington carrier strike group to the region, signaling readiness for further operations if required. Regional governments are on high alert, with increased military preparedness and diplomatic efforts to de-escalate tensions.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple Iranian sources report coordinated missile launches from Yazd, Kermanshah, Zanjan, Arak, and Kurdistan provinces, suggesting a synchronized response to US strikes. Local reports from Sirich indicate casualties from an airstrike on a wedding ceremony, though the responsible party has not been independently confirmed. Hezbollah-affiliated channels are actively mapping cross-border incidents, indicating sustained low-level conflict along the Lebanon-Israel border. The US has targeted Iranian radar systems near the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran was reportedly rebuilding, suggesting a strategic effort to degrade Iranian defensive capabilities. Open-source intelligence indicates continued missile activity from Iran, with reports of launches every few minutes throughout the evening.
